description: Extract text from scanned PDFs with real OCR: pages are rendered and recognized in your browser, then shown with copy and download.

faqs.a: Tesseract.js is loaded on demand from the jsDelivr CDN when you start OCR. If it can't load (offline/blocked), you'll get an honest error instead of a fake result.
Clean, high-contrast scans at 150+ DPI work best. Handwriting, skewed pages and tiny fonts reduce accuracy.
Yes — rendering and recognition run entirely in your browser. The OCR engine loads from a CDN but your PDF is never uploaded anywhere.

howto: Click "Run OCR" and wait while each page is recognized.
Copy text per page or download everything as a .txt file.
title: PDF OCR Tool
